# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## Repository overview

Personal website (unstoppablemango.io). F# compiled to JavaScript via Fable, styled with Tailwind v4, deployed as a Cloudflare Worker. Infrastructure managed with Pulumi TypeScript.

## Tech stack

- **Frontend:** F# + [Sutil](https://github.com/davedawkins/Sutil) (reactive Elmish-style UI, no React)
- **Compiler:** [Fable](https://fable.io/) (F# → JS)
- **Bundler:** webpack
- **Styling:** Tailwind v4 utility classes
- **Runtime:** Cloudflare Workers + Assets
- **Auth:** Cloudflare Access (`/.auth/me`, `/.auth/login/:provider`, `/.auth/logout`)
- **Infra:** Pulumi TypeScript (`infra/`)
- **Dev environment:** Nix flake (`flake.nix`) or plain Node + .NET

## Key commands

```bash
npm ci              # Install deps (also runs dotnet tool restore)
npm start           # Fable watch + webpack dev server on :8080
npm run start:all   # Full stack: Fable + Tailwind watch + wrangler dev
npm run build       # Production build (Fable → JS → webpack + tailwind minify)
npm run lint        # ESLint (ignores webpack.config.js, src/App/**, test/App.Tests/**, and public/**)
npm test            # Compile tests with Fable, run with mocha
fantomas <file>     # Format F# code (dotnet tool, installed via dotnet tool restore)
make infra          # pulumi up --cwd infra (preview/deploy infrastructure)
```

## Build pipeline

`src/App/*.fs` → Fable → `src/App/*.fs.js` (generated, gitignored) → webpack → `public/bundle.js`

Webpack entry point is `src/App/App.fs.js`.

## F# app structure (`src/App/`)

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `App.fs` | Entry point: stylesheet loading, title, hash-based router, Sutil mount |
| `Navigable.fs` | Hash routing — `bindHash` maps hash → view; `nav` sets hash |
| `Auth.fs` | Elmish store for `/.auth/me`; exposes `model`, `dispatch`, `principal`, and active patterns `Loading\|LoggedOut\|Principal` |
| `Components.fs` | Shared UI primitives (`page` wrapper) |
| `pages/` | One module per route: `Hero`, `Login`, `Music`, `Artists`, `Cannes`, `Wishlist` |

## Coding conventions

- Use **Sutil** `Html.*` helpers for DOM elements. The `c` suffix (e.g., `Html.divc`) takes a class string for Tailwind utility classes — prefer it over `Attr.className`.
- Write reactive state with Elmish (`init`/`update`/`view` pattern) using `Store` from Sutil.
- Add new pages as a new `.fs` file under `src/App/pages/`, then wire routing in `App.fs` and `Navigable.fs`.
- Format all F# files with `fantomas` before committing.
- Prefer functional, immutable F# idioms; avoid mutable state except where Sutil/browser APIs require it.
- Infrastructure changes go in `infra/` (TypeScript); follow the existing Pulumi resource patterns there.

## Testing

- Tests live in `test/App.Tests/`.
- `npm test` recompiles all tests via Fable then runs mocha on `dist/tests` — there is no single-file test runner.
- Add new tests as `.fs` files in `test/App.Tests/` and register them in the project file.

## Generated / ignored files

- `src/App/*.fs.js` — generated by Fable, do not edit manually.
- `public/bundle.js`, `public/tailwind.css` — build outputs.
- `dist/` — Fable test compilation output.

## CI

1. **build** job: `npm ci` → `npm run build` → `npm run lint` → uploads `public/` artifact.
2. **infra** job: downloads artifact, runs `pulumi preview` on PRs or `pulumi up` on `main`.
3. **nix** job: `nix flake check`.

Always ensure `npm run build` and `npm run lint` pass before marking a PR ready for review.
